name: app-6ab726767bb88191bd253a6c103c3797
description: Browse photoshoots already saved in your Charmshots account, check their status, and list existing photo metadata. Finished-photo links require sign-in to Charmshots and are not public share links. Read your own account profile, credit balance and onboarding status. The connection does not generate or analyse images, expose body measurements, edit photos, or spend credits.
